decisions.statement: A task marked done has the instant of the marking.
A task with a rule comes due again rather than reading as done.
A task anchored from completion comes round from the day of the marking.
Every other task comes round from the day that task was already due.
The day a completion is anchored on is Alan's day rather than the UTC date.
An anchor written as the text `true` is read as true.
A completion captured earlier comes round from the clock rather than from itself.
A task with no rule reads as done from the day of the marking onward.
Every page type here has a key saying the task is done.
The keys a completion touches are read from the page type marked.
A rule that will not parse leaves the due date alone.
Taking a completion back clears every key that completion set.
A second marking on the day of the first leaves the due date where the first put it.

definition: what a task has once it is marked done
